cases.source:
Guarantee

• Employer must guarantee to offer employment for at least ¾ of the total hours promised in the work contract.

• Guarantee period begins on the first workday after the worker arrives and ends on the contract expiration date, including extensions.

• Failure to meet this provision would require employer to supplement workers’ pay.
cases.claim: The employer must guarantee offering employment for at least three-quarters of the total hours promised in the work contract, with the guarantee period beginning on the first workday after the worker arrives and ending on the contract expiration date, including extensions, and failure to meet this provision requires supplementing workers’ pay.
